import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import qmnt
z = qmnt.zeros(1000)
t1, t500, t1000 = z[0], z[499], z[999]
T = t500 - t1
dw = np.pi / T
w = np.log(2)

def wave(t, om, ts):
    out = np.zeros_like(t)
    for m in (1, 2, 3):
        phase = m * om * t - m * (om - w) * ts   # equals m*w*ts at t = ts
        out += np.sin(phase) / (m * 2 ** (m / 2))
    return -out / np.pi

import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import qmnt
n = np.arange(401, 501)
t = qmnt.zeros(500)[n - 1]
tp = qmnt.oracle_zeros(n, qmnt.first_primes(6))
f = np.asarray(qmnt.fluct(t, n))
g = np.asarray(qmnt.fluct(tp, n))
N = len(f)
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
blocks = [1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 20]
B = 3000
lo, hi, mid = [], [], []
for b in blocks:
    nb = int(np.ceil(N / b))
    cs = np.empty(B)
    for i in range(B):
        starts = rng.integers(0, N, size=nb)
        idx = ((starts[:, None] + np.arange(b)[None, :]).ravel()[:N]) % N
        cs[i] = np.corrcoef(f[idx], g[idx])[0, 1]
    l, h = np.percentile(cs, [2.5, 97.5])
    lo.append(l); hi.append(h); mid.append(np.median(cs))
lo, hi, mid = map(np.array, (lo, hi, mid))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.axhspan(0.95, 0.97, color="0.85", label="paper [+0.95, +0.97]")
ax.errorbar(blocks, mid, yerr=[mid - lo, hi - mid], fmt="o", capsize=4, color="tab:blue", label="qmnt, circular block bootstrap")
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.set_xticks(blocks); ax.set_xticklabels([str(b) for b in blocks])
ax.set_xlabel("block length (levels)")
ax.set_ylabel("held-out correlation, 6-prime oracle")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower left")
plt.savefig("paper-critique_block.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")

import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import qmnt
ranges = [(401, 500), (501, 1000), (1001, 2000), (2001, 5000), (5001, 10000)]
null_p = [0.263, 0.270, 0.279, 0.288, 0.296]
six_p = [0.074, 0.083, 0.091, 0.107, 0.119]
tw5_p = [0.043, 0.050, 0.054, 0.060, 0.067]
xg = [np.sqrt(a * b) for a, b in ranges]
z = qmnt.zeros(2000)
P6 = qmnt.first_primes(6)
null_q, six_q = [], []
for a, b in ranges[:3]:
    n = np.arange(a, b + 1)
    t = z[n - 1]
    null_q.append(qmnt.rms(qmnt.fluct(t, n)))
    r, c = qmnt.score(qmnt.oracle_zeros(n, P6), n)
    six_q.append(r)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.plot(xg, null_p, "o-", mfc="none", color="k", label="null (Table V)")
ax.plot(xg, six_p, "s-", mfc="none", color="tab:blue", label="6 primes (Table V)")
ax.plot(xg, tw5_p, "^-", mfc="none", color="tab:green", label="25 primes (Table V)")
ax.plot(xg[:3], null_q, "o", color="k", label="null (qmnt)")
ax.plot(xg[:3], six_q, "s", color="tab:blue", label="6 primes (qmnt)")
ax.set_xscale("log")
ax.set_xlabel("zero index n (geometric mean of holdout range)")
ax.set_ylabel("held-out rms (mean spacings)")
ax.legend(fontsize=7)
